backlinks.title: Backlinks
backlinks.description: Sites that write about you or should, and the links that already point to your site.
backlinks.started: The search is running. Results will appear here within a few minutes.
backlinks.neverRefreshed: Not searched yet. The search runs on its own once a month.
backlinks.failed: That did not work. Please try again.
backlinks.unavailable: Link search is not available right now. Verified links are still being checked.
backlinks.disabledTitle: Backlinks are part of the Pro and Premium plans
backlinks.disabledDescription: We find sites that mention you without a link and verify every link you earn.
backlinks.policy: We never buy or trade links; Google penalises that. We only find pages that already write about you or have a reason to list you, and you contact them yourself.

live.label: Verified links
live.info: Pages on other sites where we actually found a link to your site. We check each one again every week. Links marked nofollow pass no value to search engines, but they still bring visitors.

won.label: Links earned
won.info: How many sites added a link after you wrote to them. Only links we verified on the page ourselves count.

open.label: Opportunities
open.hint: waiting for you or for a reply
open.info: Pages that mention you without a link, and manufacturers whose brands you sell. Review each one and decide whether to write.

opportunities.title: Opportunities
opportunities.description: Pages where a link to your site makes sense. Write to the author or site owner and ask for it.
opportunities.empty: No opportunities yet. They will appear here as soon as we find some.
opportunities.suppliersLocked: Manufacturer pages for the brands you sell are searched on the Premium plan.

reason.mention: The page mentions “{term}” but does not link to your site.
reason.dealers: The {brand} manufacturer lists retailers and you are not among them. | The {brand} manufacturer lists retailers and you are not among them. You sell {n} of its products. | The {brand} manufacturer lists retailers and you are not among them. You sell {n} of its products.
reason.official: The official {brand} site. Ask whether it lists retailers. | The official {brand} site. You sell {n} of its products; ask whether it lists retailers. | The official {brand} site. You sell {n} of its products; ask whether it lists retailers.

opportunities.sentOn: You wrote on {date}. We check the page every week.

check.won: The link is on the page. We counted it.
check.missing: The link is not on the page yet.
check.unreadable: The page could not be loaded right now. We will try again.
check.expired: There is still no link after 60 days, so we closed the opportunity.

draft.title: E-mail draft
draft.description: Send it from your own mailbox and adjust it as you like. Topiqu never writes to anyone for you.
draft.subject: Subject
draft.failed: The e-mail draft could not be written.

links.title: Verified links
links.description: Links to your site that we found on the pages. We check them again every week.
links.empty: We have not verified any link yet.
